column1: # One word judged on its own (AutoDetector.Suggest), against the shipped word tables.
#   mode      EN or KO, the IME mode while typing
#   typed     the keys; Hangul stands for the keys that type it (EN 안녕 = dkssud, KO 내 = so)
#   expected  what the app turns it into, or = to leave it as typed
# Characters a keyboard cannot type directly (“ · …) can be used here; whole sentences go to typing.tsv.
# Korean that stays: proper Korean even if a part reads as English
# English mode: a letter + a word is more often meant than an anonymous thing (q스킬)
# ---- English typed in English mode: stays ----
# ---- English typed in Korean mode (keys as typed, capitals with Shift) ----
# ---- Korean typed in Korean mode: stays ----
# Fuzz: a one-syllable particle after a rarer word loses to a longer ending after a common one (radio + 해도)
# Fuzz: a listed word stays whole before a common word; a name + 이 goes with the ending
